For international fans, I’ve translated this clip into English below. ⬇️

#LoveMeToHurtMe #รักเท่ากับร้าย
#TanYuyu #แทนหยู่ยู้

Character Interview

Hello, my name is Song. I'm a businesswoman running a diamond business worth tens of billions of baht. It's our family business, and I've taken over running it.

Q: What's your current relationship status?
I'm 100% single. I'm not talking to anyone.

Q: How has life been lately?
Lately? I've just been focusing on the business. I go to the office quite often, check on things, and sometimes go to look at diamonds.

Q: So you're a passionate young CEO running a huge company, right?
Yes. I'm very driven because I studied abroad. After graduating from university in Thailand, my father sent me overseas to continue my studies.

Q: Do you feel pressured?
Pressured?
A little, because I want to do a good job and make my family proud. I've also had to make some adjustments. When I came back to Thailand, I tried to apply what I'd learned abroad and adapt it to the way people work here.

Q: Does your father have high expectations of you?
My father... My father passed away. And right now, my mother is ill.

Q: So your mother needs someone to take care of her all the time, right?
Yes, she needs someone to look after her all the time. We need a nurse, so I have to hire one to take care of her full-time because my mother can't walk. She's paralyzed.

Q: Do you have any siblings?
Yes. I'm the middle child in the family. There's P'Nueng, me, and N' Sam.
N'Sam is the youngest brother in the family.

Q: What are their personalities like?
Actually, I'm really close to P'Nueng.
P'Nueng loves baking.
P'Nueng has always wanted to open a café, but P'Nueng is... um... a bit slow-paced.
As for Sam, he's probably the troublemaker of the family. He's always causing problems that we have to clean up after. That Sam!

Q: You're talented, beautiful, and have everything going for you. Are you really single?
Well, I've been in a relationship before.

Q: How many relationships have you had, K'Song?
Just one.
I don't want to talk about it.

Q: Why not?
I just don't want to talk about it. She's the one who hurt me. She broke my heart and left me. I don't want to talk about her, and I don't want to see her.

Q: Summer or rainy season?
Rainy season.

Q: What does that remind you of, K'Song?
It reminds me of the day we broke up.

Q: What was your relationship like back then?
Whenever it rains, I think about that day.
I loved her so much.
I gave her everything I had.
I gave her everything, but I still don't understand why things turned out that way.

Q: Why did the relationship end?
Maybe I just wasn't good enough.
Maybe I couldn't give her anything.

Q: "I couldn't give her anything." Is that really true?
No, it's not true. I could give her everything. I just never thought she would be that kind of person. That's all.
Or maybe that's who she really was all along, and I just never knew. She'd been deceiving me the whole time.

Q: Have you ever run into each other by chance?
Yes, because she came to work as my mother's nurse.

Q: Coincidence or fate?
I don't know if it's fate. How could something be that much of a coincidence?

Q: Would you want another coincidence like that?
I don't know.
I already told you I don't want to see her.

(You really don't want to see her?)
Yes.
I never want to see her face again.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to say to her?
You'd better be ready.
Uttawadee.
I'm coming for you.

For international fans, I’ve translated this clip into English below, and added English CC to the video. ⬇️

Coming up next, let's take a look at the blessing ceremony for TanYuyu's series, Love Me To Hurt Me.

Tan Duangkaew and Yuyu Ornicha lead the cast, joined by Ong, Gap, Candy, Kate, May, Fluke, P'Big, and P'Kwan.
Along with Channel 3 executives Dew Pinkamol and Somrak Narongwichai, and Director Nay Saratswadee.

They held an auspicious blessing ceremony ahead of the premiere of Love Me To Hurt Me on Friday, November 6. TanYuyu were all smiles, excited for everyone to finally see their work!

Tan : We're so excited! The series is finally coming on November 6! 

Yuyu : So many fans came today. We've already greeted everyone, and there's so much delicious food!

Tan : We hope everything goes smoothly. 

Yuyu : And that the whole series will be a huge success!

Yuyu : Episode 1 will set up the story and help everyone understand the bigger picture. 

Tan : Get ready to fall apart, Uttawadee!

Yuyu : Please stay tuned for Love Me To Hurt Me, premiering on November 6!
